name: BounceCards-TS-TW
title: BounceCards
description: Five square photos with thick white borders and rounded corners sit in a tilted fan over a black stage. They pop in with a bounce and drift apart when you hover over one.
use: A portfolio, gallery or team page wants a playful cluster of square photos.
avoid: Tight layouts: the hover push moves cards up to 160px sideways and needs room.
a11y: The spread is mouse-only, alt text is just card-0 and so on, and the motion ignores reduced-motion. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Five square photo cards with thick white frames and rounded corners are fanned across a black stage, each tilted a little and overlapping its neighbours. Soft shadows lift them off the background.
behaves: On load the cards scale up from nothing one after another with a springy overshoot. Hovering a card straightens it and pushes the others aside, and leaving restores the original fan.
customise: The image list, container size, entrance delay and stagger, easing, hover spread and each card's transform are props. Border and rounding are fixed classes.
weight: light: Five image cards with one entrance timeline and short hover tweens.
